founder_post: I am testing a Netherlands expansion for ProcessEd Intelligence, focused on construction, civils, roads, drainage, water, maintenance, public works, and infrastructure opportunities from Dutch and EU procurement sources. The current demo is sample data, not verified live coverage. It shows source coverage, ranked opportunities, buyer signal, urgency, recommended action, and a weekly-review style dashboard. I am looking for practical feedback from Dutch contractors and suppliers, UK/DACH firms exploring the Netherlands, and teams that already watch TenderNed or TED/EU notices.
